deferral_rationale: Reconciler r1 severity downgrade BLOCKER->CONCERN (workflow.yaml reconciler_special_case), immediately re-raised at CONCERN. The defect is real (worktree-vs-index comparison at scripts/verify_served_dashboards.py:83) but cannot flip the probe's FAIL signal: verdict_fail at line 150 reads only sha-divergence + marker counts, both computed served-vs-ON-DISK, so every Cloudflare edge transform still FAILs regardless of index state; the dirty column is WARN-only by approved plan design, and plan step C itself prescribed the index-comparing command form (git diff --stat on the path), so the code is plan-faithful. Surviving risk: a staged-but-uncommitted public artifact escapes the advisory WARN — a missing annotation, never a false FAIL / false PASS of the FAIL condition. Fix is one line (compare vs HEAD) and stays binding via the CONCERN re-raise.
